activity_summary: You came back to the open leaf and read the top of it and the verse. The chronicle was still standing, and you did not take it down. You did not pick up the pen.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the leaf in the afternoon light and left the pen in the rest.

entities.name: Holinshed's Chronicles
